summary: This experimental document defines the Previous-Hop Insertion Block for the DTN Bundle Protocol. A forwarding node inserts an endpoint ID it belongs to, and this is passed to the next node. The receiver can then know where the bundle came from.

eli5.summary: Each stop in a relay writes its own name on the parcel, so the next stop knows who handed it over.
